prompt: A horde of dozens of small green-skinned goblin warriors charging across a war-torn battlefield, a chaotic mob seen in a wide shot, all running south-east toward the viewer, brandishing crude rusted iron cleavers, jagged spears and dented round shields, mouths open mid-warcry, kicking up clouds of brown dust. The goblins wear scraps of leather and bent scrap-metal armor. The background is a smoke-darkened red dusk sky over a churned muddy field with broken siege fences.

Low worm-eye view looking up at a single snarling green goblin warrior in the foreground, roaring, raising a notched rusty cleaver overhead to strike down at the viewer, his eyes wild and yellow tusks bared. Behind and above him a churning mass of dozens more goblin warriors with raised spears and torches presses forward as a dense horde. The goblins wear soot-stained leather and scrap armor. The background is a fiery orange smoke-filled sky.

A burly green goblin warlord standing on a pile of rubble, hoisting a tall tattered crimson war-banner on a crooked pole, the torn flag catching the wind. Below and around him a swarming horde of dozens of smaller goblin warriors raises spears and flaming torches, a sea of bodies receding into haze. The goblins wear scrap-iron armor and bone trophies. The background is a dark night sky lit orange by torchlight and distant burning buildings.

A horde of green goblin warriors swarming up scaling ladders against the foot of a tall grey stone fortress wall at night, dozens of small figures clambering over each other with torches and crude axes, an overrun siege. Defenders barely visible atop the battlements. The goblins wear dark leather and dented scrap armor. The background is a moonlit night sky with the looming silhouette of the castle gatehouse.

A ragged horde of dozens of green goblin warriors cresting the top of a grassy ridge and pouring down the slope toward the viewer at dawn, a long jagged silhouette of raised spears and axes breaking the skyline. The front goblins are mid-sprint, leather-clad and snarling, the ones behind a dense bristling mass. The background is a pale gold sunrise sky with low morning mist over rolling green hills.

A tightly packed wall of green goblin warriors filling the whole frame shoulder to shoulder, a front rank of snarling tusked faces under dented helmets, fists and rusty cleavers and a forest of upright spears thrust skyward behind them, a roaring war-mob. The goblins wear soot-stained leather and bent scrap-iron plates. The background is a hazy red-brown battlefield sky barely visible between the spears.

A pitched battle: a horde of dozens of small green goblin warriors on the left crashing into a thin line of tall armored human soldiers on the right, both sides fully visible, goblins swinging rusty cleavers and the soldiers raising silver swords and kite shields, bodies colliding in the center, dust and sparks flying. The goblins wear scrap leather; the humans wear steel plate. The background is a grey overcast battlefield sky over a muddy churned field.

A three-quarter view of a goblin war-horde mid-charge across an open green field, one big snarling green goblin warrior leading at full sprint in the foreground swinging a heavy notched cleaver, a deep dense mass of dozens more goblins fanning out behind him with spears and shields raised. The goblins wear soot-stained leather and dented scrap-metal armor. The background is a bright overcast sky over trampled grassland with a distant treeline.
